newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia sees 200 mln mobile users end-1997.
newsitem.headline: Nokia sees 200 mln mobile users end-1997.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy said on Tuesday it expected the number of mobile phone subscribers globally to approach 200 million this year and reach 400-500 million by the year 2000.

"We are looking at close to 200 million subscribers at the end of the year," Pekka Ala-Pietila, head of Nokia's mobile phone arm, told a telephone conference with analysts after Nokia's first-quarter result announcement.
Asked to give his view on the number by the year 2,000, he said he expected it to be "400-450 million, mostly digitial."
The GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications) standard where Nokia is particularly strong accounted for two thirds of all digital mobile phones in use last year, he said.
